en: The postcard shows a colorized image of the Königin Luise Stein (Queen Louise Stone) monument set in a wooded area in Bad Pyrmont, Germany. The monument consists of a large stone with an inscribed plaque. Above the monument is the text 'BAD PYRMONT Königin Luise Stein 1806-1906.' In the lower section of the front side, there is a portrait of a woman, likely Queen Louise of Prussia. The back side includes standard postcard markings, the printed word 'Postkarte' in a stylized font, an emblem for 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont,' and publication details from 'M. Glückstadt & Münden, Hamburg.'
